annotations.title: Formal check of a safety data sheet text

description: Use this when someone has the text of a safety data sheet and asks whether it is complete or in the current format: "Is my safety data sheet complete?", "Does this SDS follow Annex II / Regulation 2020/878?". Formal check of the text of a safety data sheet, the same as the page /de/sdb-check: which subsections of Annex II to REACH (format of Regulation (EU) 2020/878) are present, check digits of UFI and CAS numbers, hazard codes outside CLP, revision date and version. Pass the extracted text of the PDF. The text is checked in memory and not stored. It never says a sheet is correct in content. Do not use to judge whether classification, hazards or values in the sheet are correct; it checks form, not content. Pass the text, not a file link.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

text.description: Text of the safety data sheet, all pages
